# Waqt

> Waqt (وقت, "time") at https://mywaqt.app is a free prayer-centered life tracker — a calendar where the five daily Islamic prayers are the fixed anchor and everything else is scheduled around them.

## What it is

A PWA (web, iOS via Capacitor, Android) that combines prayer accountability with everyday planning. Prayer tracking is free forever; accountability features are never paywalled.

## Core features

- Prayer-anchored calendar: day, month, and list views with the five prayers rendered as fixed background bands; overlapping events stack side-by-side.
- One-tap prayer check-in: log each salah, record masjid attendance, see green completion marks and streaks.
- Prayer analytics: consistency percentage, average prayer time, masjid attendance rate per prayer.
- Qadaa tracker: count down missed prayers owed per salah (fajr, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha).
- Prayer friends: share a six-character code, send friend requests, compare streaks, send reminders and encouragement.
- Prayer groups: invite-code groups (up to 20 members) for shared accountability.
- Masjid finder: nearby masjids with iqamah and Jumu'ah times from mosque websites, community submissions, and public registries.
- Full offline support: events, prayer logging, and qadaa queue locally and sync on reconnect.
- Prayer time notifications: push alerts when each prayer window opens, plus event reminders.
- Tools: dhikr counter, Qibla compass, Hijri calendar, 99 Names of Allah, curated talks library.
- Homework & classes, goals (weekly + long-term), recurring events, public calendar sharing via named links.

## Principles

- Prayer accountability is free forever.
- Unmarked prayers auto-resolve as "assumed prayed" — the app never punishes missing data.
- No AI-generated religious content; dhikr and talks come from a human-curated content bank.
- No ads, no tracking pixels; user data is scoped per account and never shared between accounts.

## Tech

Next.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM on Neon Postgres, Vercel hosting, service-worker offline with IndexedDB outbox, web-push notifications, AlAdhan API for prayer times.
